text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the DevOps Engineer position at Skyward Logistics. With a strong background in backend development, systems management, and cloud infrastructure, I am eager to bring my technical skills and dedication to your engineering team.

My practical experience includes building and deploying applications in cloud environments. During my internship as a Backend Developer at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot, wrote PostgreSQL queries and Flyway migrations, and improved the performance of our slowest settlement report from 9 seconds to 1.2 seconds using indexes. Additionally, I handled payment events using Kafka consumers, wrote JUnit tests, and participated in the team's on-call rotation for two months, which strengthened my approach to system reliability and incident response.

In my project work, I developed a library management system using Spring Boot, MySQL, and JWT authentication, and successfully deployed it on AWS EC2. I also built a URL shortener in Go with Redis caching, which I load-tested to 2,000 requests per second. My foundational skills include working with Git, Linux, and AWS services such as EC2 and S3. While I am continuously expanding my expertise in modern cloud-native tooling, my solid grounding in backend systems and software engineering principles makes me ready to contribute effectively to Skyward Logistics.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs for the DevOps Engineer role. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
